description.value: D-Plus Pizza is a locally-owned and operated pizza and Indian food chain with five locations across Surrey and Delta, BC. Originally founded as D Hut Pizza in the Fraser Valley, it grew by blending classic pizza with Indian-influenced dishes like butter chicken pizza, paneer pizza, samosas, and channa bathura. Cyclists stopping here can expect a varied menu available for walk-in pickup or online pre-order.
